title: pinus teocote var. herrerae
intro: Pinus teocote var. herrerae, commonly known as the Mexican pinyon pine, is a variant of the Pinus teocote tree, native to the mountains of Mexico and the southwestern United States. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to help manage respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pinus teocote var. herrerae include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
